name: 19749-largeimage-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1. Single-GPU is part of the declaration; do not shard it.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration: 36-layer bf16 language model, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 4096; 27-layer vision tower at patch_size 16, spatial_merge_size 2.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 200 requests with a 1500 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn chat, one 2560x1440 JPEG photograph (quality 85, gradient content) plus 256 text tokens per request, 32 output tokens.
purpose: A photo analysis assistant describing one high-resolution image per short prompt, single stream, on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is dropped by the line-based reader.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
disable-radix-cache: true
